notes.title: Game soon will be close
notes.content:
That was our first game on Steam. And it was more like test game. So quality of this game is not enought for us. So we want to delete it.
Thank you for your support and you can try our new games with much higher quality ;)

notes.title: Late game updates, bugfix
notes.content:
H!
Several last weeks I fixed bugs that players found. Right now it is stable version.
Plus now in game not 137 levels, but 500) It is pleaser to see players that played more then 150 hours) So even to hardcore players there will be a lot of space for playing. All supporting things for late game changed too.
Thank you for helping me make Hero Rush better!

notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Yesterday and today, quite a few edits have been made.
Firstly, I've corrected the art. I squeezed all the textures, and now the quality of the image has improved significantly. In fact, all the pictures became four times more detailed. I hope the picture will be much easier to perceive.
Secondly, I've corrected the localization. In some places - well, 1% of the menu - was without localization. Now I've found and fixed it. Thank you for your patience)
Thirdly, I've fixed many small things. The "Esc" button led to the exit from the game, and now with the click of it opens the settings menu. Previously, the "Spacebar" button could stop the fight, and many people did not understand what was happening when they pressed it. :) That's why I just deactivated this feature, since the players do not like it, because I'm making a game for you, not for myself :) Also many more minor details are fixed.
I hope you will continue to play my game, and I will try to please you with new patches and I will fix all the problems if they suddenly arise.
